name: Indelible Flame
description: A flame that can be extinguished with water or controlled using a room variable, depending on its configuration.

fields.name: Flame Option
fields.description: Defines the flame's behavior and activation method.

0.name: Water-Extinguishable
0.description: The flame can be extinguished with water.

2.name: Variable-Extinguishable
2.description: The flame can be extinguished using a room variable.

16.name: Variable-Activated
16.description: The flame starts extinguished and can be activated using a room variable.

19.name: Variable-Controlled
19.description: The flame can be switched on and off using a room variable.

fields.name: Extinguish Result Variable
fields.description: The room variable set to 1 when the flame is extinguished.

fields.name: Trigger Variable
fields.description: The room variable used to activate or extinguish the flame.
